text: Merged PR #6574 (#6195/#6196/#6198): close_runtime_scope() no longer releases live native/Automation objects, revokes Foxtools RegFn/RegFn32 registrations, or closes low-level FOPEN/FCREATE handles for CLOSE DATABASE(S) -- only true CLOSE ALL still closes low-level files, matching VFP9's documented CLOSE contract (verified against retained real VFP9 SP2 probe evidence in each issue). 2 review rounds: round 2 reconciled RQ-CF-PRG-RELEASE-DURING-CALL-001 (its own text described CLOSE ALL/DATABASES as a bulk-object-removal trigger, now false) and widened CLOSE-spelling test coverage. Also corrected a false docs/22 completion claim these three issues each cited. Deliberately NOT fixed: #6197 (CLOSE DATABASE(S)/TABLES scoping by DBC membership) -- the runtime has no DBC table-membership tracking anywhere yet (RuntimeDatabaseState has no member-table list; OPEN DATABASE only validates the container header), overlapping cluster 18's DBC-command-surface gap; disclosed as a real, separate, larger prerequisite. Surveyed cluster 27 ([Architecture] proposals, #6017-6025/#6043): all 10 are large multi-session design epics, not closeable bugs -- read-only, informs future cluster 2/14/19 work. Scoped but did not start #6199 (ON SHUTDOWN ignores non-DO commands: needs the registered handler text run through the real statement dispatcher with QUIT's control flow redirected to it, plus recursive-QUIT/fault/cancellation handling -- a multi-round epic like cluster 27's own proposals, not a slice) and #6263 (uncommitted transactions survive session destruction: the fix is real and identified -- ~Impl() never calls cleanup_runtime_resources_for_shutdown() or rolls back open transaction journals, while replay_pending_transaction_journals() already exists and does this correctly but only runs at a NEW session's startup, opportunistically, if it happens to scan the same temp directory -- but properly wiring + testing it (destructor-time behavior, multiple data sessions, cleanup-failure paths) is real work, not started this session). Session paused here; queued for next resume: #6263 (best next pick, contained fix already identified), then #6183/#6454, then #6199 if there's runway for a bigger slice.
